_help.currency: ISO code used for every money field in every file.
_help.months: One row per calendar month, oldest first, month as YYYY-MM.
_help.revenue: Invoiced or booked revenue for the month.
_help.cash_collected: Money that actually landed in the account.
_help.expenses: Everything paid out, including contractors and ads.
_help.recurring_revenue: The part of revenue that repeats next month.
_help.cash_on_hand: Bank balance on the day you updated this file.
_help.committed_future_revenue: Signed but undelivered work, by month.
